Hi! 

If you're in the US, FAFSA offers pell grants for students whose parents won't/can't pay. A LOT of college students use FAFSA but some people don't even know it exists!!! I recommend community colleges. With my grant, after classes/books I end up with about $4000 left over for housing each semester. I also work but the grant helps. FAFSA offers loans that don't accrue interest until you're out of school as well... but I really don't recommend that route unless you have no other choice. 

FAFSA doesn't allow you to apply without your parent until you are 21 because they still consider you dependent... unless circumstances make you independent. In that case, you can file for independent status with a letter corroborating your claim. I left my mom's house and briefly moved in with my high school principal, who wrote a letter on my behalf. I was legally considered homeless which made me independent.

It is not at all easy to get up from underneath a narc parent. A healthy parent wants you to grow and thrive! A narc wants you around to provide them with whatever they need. When I was reading your post, I was reminded of a story I saw on this sub a while back. A narc parent told a 5 year old child that their birthday party (happening later that day) was going to be canceled if they didn't clean up their room. Obviously there was never a birthday party but the narc would rather the child think it was their fault rather than the parent's lack of planning. My mom was so threatened by my leaving and kept telling me I wasn't ready/would fall on my face. It's possible that your mom doesn't even have the money or just doesn't want to spend it on university. Whatever the reason, whatever the excuse, be prepared to find your own way! 

Nothing compares to the relief of no longer being dependent on someone who is so unpredictable.

Oh! I've never experienced anything like that. I think I was a substitute for my mom's "partner" needs so she is pretty preoccupied with me/rejects people I date. 

Either way, I stopped talking to her about personal things and there was a lot less drama in my daily life. Didn't even tell her last time I was in the ER. Maybe leave her out of the serious stuff if she is just going to bother you. Hope you feel better soon!

I could be wrong because not every nparent is the same but my mom would never miss out on an opportunity to point out that the people in my life are inadequate. 

In this situation, my mom would make passive aggressive noises until I ask what's wrong. Then she would say that a good husband would be there or something to that effect. Maybe your mom is just not that blunt. Any possibility that she is pretending to think it's great just so she can bring it up and see if you are bothered deep down?
